data.name: Arcane Strike (Mythic)
data.description: Using your amazing arcane talents, you can deliver devastating blows infused with magical energy. Whenever you use Arcane Strike to enhance your weapons, the effect lasts for 1 minute instead of 1 round. If you expend one use of mythic power when using Arcane Strike, you can also add any one magic weapon special ability with a base price modifier of to your weapons.
